title: Valvular Heart Disease Registry
official: Valvular Heart Disease Registry - Observational Study of Percutaneous Valvular Interventions
summary: Patients undergoing transcatheter valvular interventions will be prospectively included into the present registry. Baseline, procedural and follow-up data will be collected and analyzed to adress various issues in the field of percutaneous valvular interventions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Severe valvular defect planned for valvular intervention

Exclusion Criteria:

\- No informed consent
